theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u e : Euclid P) (s : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P), ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ u e = 0 → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (-s) s) → (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖γ α‖ = 1 ∧ 0 < inner ℝ (γ α) u ∧ Real.arctan (inner ℝ (γ α) e / inner ℝ (γ α) u) = α) → (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖deriv γ α‖ = inner ℝ (γ α) u ^ 2 + inner ℝ (γ α) e ^ 2) → ∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, γ α = Real.cos α • u + Real.sin α • e
